scope: Proposition 9.5 (Exclusion of larger marginal obstacles) of the manuscript “The spacetime Penrose inequality with charge and original-data rigidity” (preprints/The-spacetime-Penrose-inequality-with-charge-and-original-data-rigidity-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 84ca5bc05bc907a1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 62. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is no full smooth enlarged obstacle B of the type described at the start of this section which contains an additional open subset of Ω outside the original filled obstacle and is marginal with an arbitrary fixed choice of sign on each component. For the original obstacle, the area term in Equation (9.9) is exactly a′ S(h) = 1 2 R S trS h dA.
